thread:
Alisha: running a MRK failover rehearsal and hit a KMS AccessDenied when we routed to the replica in eu-west-1
Matt: can you paste the error log?
Alisha: 
```
ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Decrypt operation: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:444444444444:key/replica-uuid
```
Alisha: we assume a cross-account role (our infra account -> customer acct) and call Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for envelope flow
Jordan: important note: MRK replica keys are distinct CMKs with separate grants & policies even though they share key material. Grants do not automatically replicate
Matt: so if the cross-account role was granted on primary only, replica will deny Decrypt. That matches AccessDenied on replica ARN
sre-jen: also confirm whether the code path used ReEncryptFrom/ReEncryptTo or plain Decrypt. ReEncrypt flows require permissions on both source+destination keys
Alisha: our flow: GenerateDataKey plaintext returned, cache DEK for 45s, encrypt locally. On region switch we sometimes call Decrypt against the (replica) CMK for the boxed DEK created by primary -> denied
Jordan: mitigation options we discussed: add matching grants on each replica for the cross-account role; or widen key policy to include the role; or switch to GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + ReEncrypt to avoid moving plaintext across regions
Matt: example grant we applied in test (CLI):
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:444444444444:key/replica-uuid \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/CrossAcctDecryptRole \
  --operations Decrypt ReEncryptFrom ReEncryptTo GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
```
Jordan: small reminders: 1) grantee must be role ARN (not session), 2) if automation creates grants, track grantTokens and retirement if needed, 3) alias ARNs in logs vs CMK ARN mismatch is a common trap
sre-jen: runbook update proposal: on MRK failover event: flush DEK caches, create or verify grants on target replica, and prefer GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext when possible
Alisha: will add a hook to the router to invalidate DEK caches and to run a grants-check job during replication pipeline
Matt: also add a unit/integration test to simulate assumed role decrypt against replica ARNs and assert CloudTrail shows successful kms:ReEncryptFrom or Decrypt calls
Jordan: log tip: CloudTrail shows the exact key ARN that rejected the call; search for kms:Decrypt AccessDenied entries to find which replica lacks permissions
sec-bot: created issue INFRA-9123 (kms-replica-grants) assigned to Alisha, due 3d
Alisha: thanks — I'll spin up a small playbook and PR the grants automation. Will also check whether we can default to ReEncrypt path in fallback router to reduce plaintext transfer :thumbsup:
